description.en:
More complete facial rebalancing after six progressive sessions.
Face appears more centred and aligned.
Eyes and cheekbones look more balanced.
Facial structure appears more lifted and three-dimensional.
Contours look clearer, firmer and more refined.
Overall changes appear more established and harmonious.
description.zh:
經過六次循序漸進的 Session，面部得到更完整的重新平衡。
面部看起來更端正對齊。
雙眼及顴骨位置更平衡協調。
面部結構更提升、更具立體感。
輪廓更清晰、緊緻及細緻。
整體變化更穩定、更和諧。
